claims.text: The resort is set along the shores of Nusa Dua, with seven lagoons flowing through tropical gardens that extend to the beachfront.

findings.quote: Set along the shores of Nusa Dua, The Laguna Bali is shaped by seven lagoons that flow through lush tropical gardens, creating a tranquil landscape that extends naturally to the beachfront.

claims.text: The resort has seven lagoon-shaped swimming pools.

findings.quote: seven lagoon-shaped swimming pools

claims.text: Waterfalls greet guests from the lobby as the lagoon stretches to the beach; there are two sandy beaches, a dedicated pool area and two jacuzzis.

findings.quote: Waterfalls welcome you from the lobby of our spa resort in Bali, Indonesia, as the lagoon lazily stretches to the beach. Two sandy beaches, a dedicated pool area, and two jacuzzis entice guests to enjoy the water.

claims.text: Rooms feature traditional Balinese decor such as woven keben baskets, used to carry offerings at temples, and low-rise dulang tables with local tropical fruits.

findings.quote: Traditional décor includes woven keben baskets, typically used to carry offerings at temples, and low-rise dulang tables that carry colorful spreads of local tropical fruits

claims.text: Specially commissioned artwork in the rooms pays tribute to the island's arts and crafts.

findings.quote: specially commissioned artwork pays tribute to the island’s arts and crafts

claims.text: The villas have marble bathrooms and butler service.

findings.quote: Each of our Bali villas on Nusa Dua beach has indulgent beds, marble bathrooms and butler service

claims.text: Pool villas each have their own expansive private pool, and a 24-hour butler service is offered.

findings.quote: There are also 11 pool villas, each of which boasts its own expansive private pool. A 24-hour butler service ensures guests need not lift a finger while onsite.

claims.text: The Lagoon Spa offers Balinese massages with coconut oil.

findings.quote: features indoor treatment rooms, an outdoor gazebo and Balinese massages with coconut oil

claims.text: Trinity Courts offers tennis, padel and pickleball amid tropical gardens.

findings.quote: Play amidst lush tropical gardens at our newly opened Trinity Courts, featuring tennis, padel, and pickleball for both leisure and active pursuits.

claims.text: Kids' activities inspired by Bali's indigenous heritage include natural batik printing, the traditional Deduplak game and clay bottle painting.

findings.quote: inspired by Bali’s indigenous heritage featuring natural batik printing, the traditional Deduplak game, & clay bottle painting

claims.text: Arwana is a beachfront grill restaurant whose Basque grills flame-cook seafood and dry-aged meats.

findings.quote: A lively and transitional beachfront grill restaurant in Bali with a modern and inviting nautical ambiance, Arwana showcases Basque grills that expertly flame-cook the finest seafood and dry-aged cuts of meat

claims.text: The resort is a Green Key-certified establishment.

findings.quote: The Laguna Bali is a Green Key-certified establishment.

claims.text: Rooms offer views of fragrant gardens from private balconies or direct access to the lagoon's warm waters; in a Lagoon Access Room guests can step from the private balcony directly into the water.

findings.quote: Guests can unwind with views of lush, fragrant gardens from private balconies or enjoy direct access to the lagoon’s warm waters.
the best spot might be in a Lagoon Access Room, which allows you to step from your private balcony directly into the water

claims.text: The Lagoon Spa has indoor treatment rooms, a treatment gazebo overlooking the Indian Ocean and a private relaxation lounge with steam and sauna.

findings.quote: our award-winning spa features indoor treatment rooms, a treatment gazebo overlooking the Indian Ocean, and a private relaxation lounge with steam and sauna facilities

claims.text: On the white sand beach, cabanas offer shade and beachside wellness treatments.

findings.quote: Our white sand beach invites guests to bask in the world-famous beauty and sunshine of Bali. When the temperatures rise, cabanas offer tempting respite with cool shade and beachside wellness treatments.

claims.text: Guests can take part in a Balinese blessing ceremony, and a daily Jamu Ritual is held at 6pm in de Bale Lounge & Bar.

findings.quote: Through a Balinese blessing ceremony, guests can share in a tradition
Join us at 6:00 PM daily in de Balé Lounge & Bar for our signature Jamu Ritual.

claims.text: Guests can explore Kedonganan fish market accompanied by the resort's chef.

findings.quote: Accompanied by our chef, explore Kedonganan fish market and enjoy an opportunity to engage with the local Balinese.

claims.text: The airport is 11 km from the property.

findings.quote: I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport - Bali
Distance from Property: 11.0 KM

WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury beachfront resorts.
